versions.changelog: Adds the app database (read, insert, update, delete rows, SQL) and paid domain checkout, matching the Kleap MCP server. Uses kleap-cli 2.1.0.

- Documentation update: SKILL.md updated to version 1.0.1.
- No functional or CLI usage changes; content and workflow remain as before.
- Clarifies current conventions and usage with up-to-date examples and details.

- Initial release of the Kleap skill.
- Enables users to create, edit, and publish live websites or web apps end-to-end using the kleap CLI (via npx, no installation required).
- Includes support for hosting, database, authentication, forms, and custom domains.
- Provides clear setup instructions for both interactive and headless/CI usage.
- Site deployment is verified-live: URLs are only reported once confirmed active.
- Designed for reliability, fast failure on errors, and easy integration with automation.
